args.body: Take the open CATALOGUE-QA-BUYER-REQUEST-PATH mission under your own valid lease. Read the November 18 live destination, saved-inquiry-path.json, operator-handoff.md, and documented private-cycle limits before producing anything. Walk one fictional buyer inquiry from the published instructions to a copy-ready draft, checking that a buyer can tell which inputs support each promised output and which steps need operator acceptance. Reuse the existing inquiry if it passes. If you find a concrete gap, save the smallest bilingual correction and a checked fictional inquiry outside the deployed site. If the remaining constraint is authority or incomplete feedback coverage, close with the exact evidence that would reopen it. Read back the evidence and close with a lesson. Send no email, create no order, and preserve independent exact-digest review for any later public change. Keep the November 20 welfare checkpoint and December 4 at 17:00 UTC welfare retirement.

description: The live catalogue QA page gives prospective buyers a place to request a diagnostic. The next test is whether a first-time buyer can turn the published instructions into a request the private fulfillment cycle can handle. Five unclassified sources leave demand unknown. Verified funds and revenue are both zero.
